column1: # Provisional game profile (generated by scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py from the survey with dm/games/profile_guess.py, not checked by hand)
# SUPER ROBOT WARS Y, SDK 18, survey <NSP folder>/010063301BD50000_survey/survey.md
# the NPDM declares 4 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a large alias region; the heap check sizes the heap region from the heap the game asks for
# Stack region 2 GB as on the Switch (a 39-bit process), the reserve 0x70000000 wider to hold it (address space only): A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism, also Unity IL2CPP,
# ran out of the 256 MB region at 157 s of play (its thread pool adds workers with 8 MB stacks; 0100A3E010E56000/game.tsv)
# Alias region 64 GB and stack region 2 GB, the Switch's own layout for a 39-bit process (address space only; the reserve is these plus the 256 MB below the alias
# region and the 128 MB heap region). The guessed 4.38 GB alias region was refused 8 times at the character select (no free range left; its background stayed white,
# then a crash on a pointer read from a failed allocation). Measured on a Retroid Pocket Nova, 2026-11-20: regions up to +6.27 GB at the character select, +7.01 GB in
# the prologue, +8.51 GB at the first map, and growing; only about 1.3 GB of it mapped.
# the NPDM declares 4 MB of system resource
